episodes.title: Ne pas déranger
episodes.summary: On her first shift in the Citadel's day-release program, Adèle is accused of theft -- and must accept a risky mission to keep her job.

episodes.title: Ceux du 7e étage
episodes.summary: The hotel buzzes as the owner's daughter Reem arrives with her fiancé Mark -- who is the target of Adèle's secretive mission from Édouard.

episodes.title: Fish and Shark
episodes.summary: As the Citadel employees resolve to go on strike, Édouard pressures Adèle to spy on her coworkers. Later, Édouard's day goes from bad to worse when he learns just how much Mark stands to gain from his marriage into the Fethani family.

episodes.title: Mission
episodes.summary: Adèle proves herself and is promoted to Reem's personal concierge. Edouard expands his influence and takes the opportunity to get to Pepo.

episodes.title: La fugitive
episodes.summary: Sacrificed by Edouard, Adèle embarks on an impossible escape, risking her life.

episodes.title: La citadelle
episodes.summary: On Reem and Mark's wedding day, Adèle plans the perfect heist with the bride's help. But nothing goes as planned.
